scenario_name: SF10 current remaining delivery planning scenario: 400 prospective hours at the retained assumed $95/hour, 150 days; no unquoted service reserve

planning_basis.rate_source: Retained assumption from the historical sf10_70000_candidate.json; not an agreed human rate or vendor quote.
planning_basis.hours_source: New engineering scope estimate after original 14-row shipped-source reconciliation; not time worked or contracted staffing.
planning_basis.capacity_required: 120 hours in days1-30; 120 in days31-90; 160 in days91-150. Actual contributor allocation remains to be recorded.
planning_basis.preaward_exclusions: All already delivered seller, catalog, approval, signer, ledger, finalizer, dataset adapters, buyer inbox, merchant outbox/receiver, recovery, monitoring and distribution source. Any further pre-award work also comes out.
planning_basis.service_basis: Use existing available fleet/container capacity. Add actual incremental units and sourced prices only when a real deployment needs them; no Actions spend.

milestones.deliverable: Independent merchant installation and recoverable operator onboarding
milestones.measurable_proof: Independent merchant operator installs the maintained release and exposes its agreed real resource, preserving method, schema, network, asset, recipient and exact terms. The same merchant changes terms, retires its old resource and recovers operation with its approved identity; a second operator completes the documented handover.

milestones.deliverable: Deployed native settlement, merchant operation and independent-provider integration with threat response
milestones.measurable_proof: A merchant resource is used through participating independent providers with exact operation identity. The original approved transaction, SF36 reservation and merchant event are correlated and survive restart without another charge. An actual deployed fault reaches the responsible operator through the installed alert path and is recovered in the same service/reservation. Complete the required threat assessment and remediation in this tranche.

milestones.deliverable: Maintained mainnet merchant release and measured operational recovery
milestones.measurable_proof: Authorized mainnet purchases deliver the original merchant product with matching transfer, request, reservation and merchant operation. Record the actual participating deployment and controlled rollback. Restore the same merchant catalog, reservation and delivery state to a new authorized host, reconcile post-backup operations and measure recovery time. An independent operator handles a real support case using the maintained release.
